## Metodologia

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="49%"}
<div style="background:#e3efe6; border:1.5px solid #3f6b52; border-radius:12px; padding:1.1rem 1rem; font-size:0.62em; height:100%;">

<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px;">
<h3 style="font-size:1.25em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d; margin:0;">🏷️ Covariáveis Qualitativas</h3>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; white-space:nowrap;">survfit()</span>
<span>Kaplan-Meier</span>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; white-space:nowrap;">survdiff()</span>
<span>Log-Rank</span>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; white-space:nowrap;">survdiff(rho=1)</span>
<span>Peto-Peto</span>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; white-space:nowrap;">pairwise_survdiff()</span>
<span>Holm-Bonferroni</span>
</div>

<div style="margin-top:4px;">
<strong>Aplicada a:</strong>
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin-top:4px;">
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">SEXO</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">ESCOLARI</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">ECGRUP</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">CATEATEND</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">CIRURGIA</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">RADIO</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(63,107,82,0.12); color:#2c5943; border:0.5px solid rgba(63,107,82,0.3);">QUIMIO</span>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
:::

<div style="background:#faf1de; border:1.5px solid #b8862a; border-radius:12px; padding:1.1rem 1rem; font-size:0.62em; height:100%;">

<div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px;">

</div>

<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">

<div>
<strong>Medidas-resumo:</strong>
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin-top:4px;">
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(184,134,42,0.1); color:#7a5a12; border:0.5px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.3);">Média</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(184,134,42,0.1); color:#7a5a12; border:0.5px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.3);">Desvio-padrão</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(184,134,42,0.1); color:#7a5a12; border:0.5px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.3);">Mediana</span>
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(184,134,42,0.1); color:#7a5a12; border:0.5px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.3);">Amplitude interquartílica</span>
</div>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#b8862a; color:#fff; white-space:nowrap;">median()</span>
<span>Dicotomização pela mediana</span>
</div>

<div style="margin-top:4px;">
<strong>Aplicada a:</strong>
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin-top:4px;">
<span style="padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; font-weight:500; background:rgba(184,134,42,0.1); color:#7a5a12; border:0.5px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.3);">IDADE</span>
</div>
</div>

<div style="margin-top:4px; padding-top:8px; border-top:1px solid rgba(184,134,42,0.25);">
<strong>Após dicotomização:</strong>
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin-top:4px;">
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#b8862a; color:#fff;">survfit()</span>
<span style="font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:700; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:5px; background:#b8862a; color:#fff;">survdiff()</span>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>

# Conclusão

## Conclusão

<div style="background:#10241d; border-radius:14px; padding:14px 26px; text-align:left; margin-bottom:14px;">
<div style="font-size:0.42em; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.09em; color:#d9b054; margin-bottom:4px;">🎯 Mensagem principal</div>
<div style="font-size:0.68em; font-weight:600; color:#ffffff; line-height:1.3;">A sobrevida mediana global é de <span style="color:#d9b054;">13,9 meses</span>, com gradientes marcantes por estadiamento, escolaridade e cirurgia; a diferença por sexo é modesta.</div>
</div>

<div style="background:#e3efe6; border:1.5px solid #3f6b52; border-radius:12px; padding:12px 16px; font-size:0.52em; color:#10241d; text-align:left; height:100%;">
<h3 style="font-size:1.15em; font-weight:700; color:#10241d; margin:0 0 8px 0;">3.1.1 Principais Achados</h3>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">GERAL</span><span>Mediana global de <b style="color:#3f6b52;">13,9 meses</b> (IC 95%: 12,8–15,0) · 2.774 óbitos em 4.231</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">SEXO</span><span>Masculino <b style="color:#3f6b52;">14,9</b> vs feminino <b style="color:#3f6b52;">12,2</b> meses · log-rank p = 0,044, diferença limítrofe</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">ESCOLARI</span><span>Mediana cresce com a escolaridade: <b style="color:#3f6b52;">6,5</b> (analfabeto) → <b style="color:#3f6b52;">28,5</b> meses (superior)</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">ECGRUP</span><span>Estágio IV <b style="color:#3f6b52;">5,3</b> meses vs estágio II <b style="color:#3f6b52;">48,3</b>; estágio I sem mediana atingida</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">CATEATEND</span><span>SUS <b style="color:#3f6b52;">31,4</b> · Particular <b style="color:#3f6b52;">24,6</b> · Convênio <b style="color:#3f6b52;">12,5</b> meses; SUS acima do Convênio, a investigar</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">CIRURGIA</span><span>Sem cirurgia <b style="color:#3f6b52;">8,8</b> meses; com cirurgia, mediana não atingida (35,8% de óbitos vs 75,4%)</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">RADIO</span><span>Com radioterapia <b style="color:#3f6b52;">25,5</b> vs <b style="color:#3f6b52;">13,5</b> meses sem (n = 188 tratados)</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">QUIMIO</span><span>Com quimioterapia <b style="color:#3f6b52;">18,6</b> vs <b style="color:#3f6b52;">9,5</b> meses sem</span></div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; padding:3px 0;"><span style="flex:0 0 6.4em; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:0.85em; font-weight:700; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:5px; background:#dcead9; color:#3f6b52; text-align:center;">IDADE</span><span>Mediana de <b style="color:#3f6b52;">63 anos</b> (Q1–Q3: 56–70) · média de 62,2</span></div>
</div>
